title: Argentinian Kissed Creamy Gratin
description: A keto twist on a classic gratin, combining the flavors of Argentinian cuisine with a creamy texture.

ingredients.name: long beans
ingredients.notes: such as green beans or haricot vert

ingredients.name: gratin
ingredients.notes: such as panko breadcrumbs or grated cheese

ingredients.name: creamy sauce
ingredients.notes: such as heavy cream or sour cream

instructions: Slice the long beans into 1-inch pieces.
In a large skillet, heat the chinese oil over medium-high heat.
Add the long beans and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, heat the creamy sauce over low heat.
Stir in the kissed argentinian cheese until melted and smooth.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, create a layer of the cooked long beans.
Pour half of the cheesy creamy sauce over the beans.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining sauce.
Sprinkle the gratin over the top and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
